idea-plugin.name: Ansible Language Server (zals)
idea-plugin.description:
Integrates zals (Zig Ansible Language Server) into PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, and other JetBrains IDEs.

Features:

  • Autocompletion for Ansible modules, directives, and variables
  • Documentation on hover
  • Go to definition (modules, roles, variables)
  • Go to implementation (role main task files)
  • Find variable references across the role or playbook
  • Real-time diagnostics via ansible-lint and syntax validation
